## First demo

::: {.incremental}
* ask Posit Assistant to fix the code in the 'world-happiness.qmd' Quarto document
* ask Posit Assistant to use the gt package to create a colorful table for the 10 happiest countries
* ask something else (another plot, a statistical analysis, a map, etc.)
:::

{{< countdown "5:00" top="0" right="0" >}}

## Data Cleaning mode

* Use the data cleaning mode to create a dataset that combines the 5 CSV files

## Create a Shiny app

* Now that we have clean data, ask Posit Assistant to create a Shiny app that lets you explore the data. For instance:

> Create a Shiny app using the clean happiness data to explore how the happiness score and rank of multiple countries change through time. Let the user select countries (multi-select) and the years (with a slider).

Things you can try:

* change the theme/colors of the app
* add other tabs with additional visualizations/tables
* use the other variables in the dataset
* ask Posit Assistant to come up with suggestions to improve your app

{{< countdown "10:00" top="0" right="0" >}}

## Sharing your apps from Positron

* Use Posit Publisher to publish to Connect (or Connect Cloud)
* Use the Git-backed integration

* Project and User Memory

## What can you build?

* Use one of the datasets provided (in the EDA folder), your own data, a public dataset, or a combination of these to build something interesting with Posit Assistant in 15 minutes
* Use Posit Publisher to publish it to Posit Connect
* Make sure to set the Access settings to "All users - login required"
* Share the URL in the Slido Q&A
